request.text:
Minutes of the 14th Meeting of the Board of Directors. Meeting No: 14.
Held on Monday, 12 May 2026. The Meeting commenced at 11:00 a.m.
Mr A Sharma took the Chair. The requisite quorum being absent, the Chairman called the
Meeting to order. RESOLVED THAT the accounts be approved.
The Meeting concluded at 12:30 p.m.
The minutes were entered in the Minutes Book on 20 May 2026.
Place: Bengaluru. Signed by the Chairman.

response.note: Every finding cites Secretarial Standards and a real ROC adjudication order. A NEEDS_BOOK item is not a defect and not a pass: it is a property of the physical minutes book that no reader of a file can decide.

findings.defect: Serial number of the meeting not stated in the minutes
findings.precedent: Sunima Trading P Ltd, ROC UP-I, 13.07.2026 — Rs 45,000; Merino Shelters, 15.05.2026

findings.defect: Time of commencement of the meeting not recorded
findings.precedent: Rashi Steel and Power, ROC Chhattisgarh, 24.03.2026 & 07.04.2026; Triveni Nidhi, 04.09.2024

findings.defect: Time of conclusion of the meeting not recorded
findings.precedent: Rashi Steel and Power, ROC Chhattisgarh, 24.03.2026 & 07.04.2026; Triveni Nidhi, 04.09.2024

findings.defect: Place at which the minutes were signed not recorded
findings.precedent: Wind World (India) Ltd, ROC Goa/Daman & Diu, 2024; Sany Heavy Industry, 17.05.2024

findings.defect: Date of entry of the minutes in the Minutes Book not recorded
findings.precedent: Harsh Gathani Enterprise, ROC Ahmedabad, 24.06.2025; Sen Hon Lee, 13.10.2025

findings.quoted_span: meeting date and/or entry date not supplied
findings.precedent: Trouw Nutrition India, ROC Telangana, 22.10.2024 — Rs 21.35 lakh across 54 board meetings

findings.defect: Minutes signed by another director on behalf of the Chairman
findings.precedent: Landomus Realty Ventures, ROC Bangalore, 31.03.2026; Dystar India, 09.09.2025

findings.defect: Minutes not written in the third person
findings.precedent: No penalty order found for tense alone — advisory

findings.defect: Minutes book pages not consecutively numbered across the whole book
findings.precedent: Rosmerta Technologies, ROC Delhi, 07.10.2025 — numbering restarted each FY; ~24 of 68 orders

findings.defect: Chairman did not initial every page of the minutes
findings.precedent: Chartered Mercantile Mutual Benefits, ROC Kanpur, 10.02.2026; Rashi Steel, 24.03.2026

findings.defect: Blank pages not scored out and not initialled by the Chairman
findings.precedent: Madhyam Agrivet Industries, ROC Pune, 30.06.2023; Rosmerta Autotech, 09.10.2025
